task.title: P6-088: Decide whether dialog, popover, and sheet should lazy-gate children by default
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 6 — Decisions the maintainer owns). Original id: P6-088. Size: M, decision first. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-components.md.

**Should `dialog`/`popover`/`sheet` gate their children on open by default?** Overlay children are instantiated eagerly, and the V2 review's "revisit only if a specific overlay's content proves expensive" has now been triggered: the card-detail previews duplicated every card name into the DOM and broke three pre-existing catalog tests, fixed with a per-caller latch that now lives in `cards.rs` as precedent. Decide whether the default changes, so the next consumer does not rediscover the latch.
